svg.title: Do GLP-1s raise or lower erectile dysfunction? It depends on the study
svg.desc: Do GLP-1s raise or lower erectile dysfunction? It depends on the study. Randomized trial, REWIND, dulaglutide vs placebo, T2D (2021): 0.92 (0.85-0.99). Health-record cohorts, Semaglutide vs no semaglutide, obesity, no diabetes (2024): 4.5 (2.3-9.0). Health-record cohorts, GLP-1 vs DPP-4 inhibitor, T2D (2026): 1.26 (1.08-1.46). Health-record cohorts, Tirzepatide vs sitagliptin, T2D (2025): 0.7 (0.64-0.76). Health-record cohorts, Tirzepatide vs injectable semaglutide, T2D (2025): 0.67 (0.62-0.72). Health-record cohorts, Tirzepatide vs dulaglutide, T2D (2025): 0.55 (0.51-0.59). FDA adverse-event reports, Semaglutide, ED reports (2026): 1.53 (1.16-2.03). FDA adverse-event reports, All GLP-1s, male sexual dysfunction (2025): 0.41 (0.36-0.48).
